name: low_mode_threshold_sample_2026-11-20
purpose: TASKS 218, GoalGathering/notes/PreRegistration_2026-11-20_Low_Mode_Repair_Threshold.md: the 20 unrepaired molecules of the registered sample (probes/low_mode_threshold_sample.py, seed 218, 5 per band of the lowest B3LYP mode in 20-60 cm-1, at most 25 atoms) patched along every label mode below 60 cm-1 with grid-response gradients (probes/low_mode_patch_run.py; pyscf hessian/test/test_rks.py finite_diff makes the same gradient call, cited in probes/hessian_grid_response_fd.py), so that probes/low_mode_threshold_read.py can read the label error against frequency and force constant. A measurement: the patched Hessians are written into the results folder; the corpus files are only read and no label is swapped

estimate.basis: probes/results_m1/low_mode_threshold_2026-11-20/sample/SAMPLE.md: 21 directions, 84 gradients and 40 reference SCFs; 6.0 h at 8 threads from the median seconds per gradient of the repairs of 13-15 Nov by atom count (72-264 s). No 4-thread timing exists: assumed 1-2 times the 8-thread time, so 6-12 h; beside the training search it will be slower by an amount nobody measured

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops it at 4096 MB (CAP_MB); the corpus repair of 13-14 Nov peaked at 3.57 GB over 57 molecules of 8-40 atoms under the same cap, and this sample stops at 25 atoms
